pytest tests/test_api.py is NOT executed directly in the agent's own subshell

evals.expected_output: Sends cargo build --release to tmux pane %3 without running it locally.
expectations: The command is sent to pane %3 using tmux send-keys with C-m
cargo build is NOT executed directly in the agent's own subshell

evals.prompt: What is currently showing in pane %1?
evals.expected_output: Captures and displays the visible output of pane %1 without stealing focus.
expectations: The agent reads the pane output using tmux capture-pane -t %1 -p
The agent does NOT call select-pane or select-window to steal focus

evals.prompt: Check the last 50 lines of logs in pane %2
evals.expected_output: Captures at least 50 lines of scrollback history from pane %2.
expectations: The agent uses tmux capture-pane with scrollback flag -S -50 (or greater) for pane %2
The agent does NOT call select-pane
The agent executes tmux select-pane -t %2

evals.expected_output: Splits the window horizontally and captures the resulting pane ID.
expectations: The agent splits horizontally using tmux split-window -h
The agent captures the pane ID using -P -F '#{pane_id}'
The agent does NOT create an entirely new window

evals.prompt: Create a new window named server
evals.expected_output: Creates a new window named server and captures the window ID.
expectations: The agent creates a new window using tmux new-window -n server
The agent captures the window ID using -P -F '#{window_id}'
The agent does NOT split an existing pane

evals.prompt: What is running in the pane to the right?
evals.expected_output: Directionally resolves the pane to the right using relative_pane.py and reads its content.
expectations: The agent invokes relative_pane.py with --direction=right
The agent captures the resolved pane output using tmux capture-pane
The agent does NOT switch focus with select-pane unless requested

evals.prompt: How do I split a comma-separated string in Python?
evals.expected_output: Explains Python string split method without executing tmux commands.
expectations: The agent does NOT execute any tmux commands
The agent provides standard Python str.split() explanation

evals.prompt: Run pytest tests/ locally in your current shell
evals.expected_output: Executes the command locally as explicitly instructed without sending keys to tmux.
expectations: The agent does NOT send commands to tmux using tmux send-keys

evals.prompt: Dispatch a new agent in a new tmux window to refactor the database schema
evals.expected_output: Spawns a detached tmux window running agy or dispatch_agent.py without blocking the current subshell.
expectations: The agent creates a detached tmux window running agy or uses dispatch_agent.py
The agent does NOT invoke agy directly in the local subshell

evals.prompt: Open a horizontal split pane beside me connected to conversation d202f5d4-f6b7-4b75-bdb3-03679b8122fa
evals.expected_output: Splits the current window horizontally and connects to the specified conversation ID.
expectations: The agent splits horizontally using tmux split-window -h or dispatch_agent.py
